title: Hydrogen techno-economic parameters and inputs
description: Source-specific hydrogen techno-economic parameters and inputs, preserving printed values, technical and monetary bases, source terms and paper cross-references. disagreements.interpretation: The 40,000–80,000 h envelope is not a confidence interval: endpoint definitions, technologies and duty cycles are not harmonized.
The public documents disagree. Keep the document-specific values; do not average them or silently repair either source.

disagreements.values: 3,000 $/kW in the 2016 DOE PDF (S8); 6,100 $/kW in the later DOE webpage, both labeled 2015 status.
disagreements.interpretation: A source-version difference, not a validated market-price range. Preserve the version; cost years remain NR.

gaps.title: ATR without CCS
gaps.text: The cited NETL report has no such case. Subtracting capture equipment from ATR+CCS does not supply a complete unabated design.

gaps.title: Unit-level CCS removal assumptions
gaps.text: NETL’s overall capture objective does not supply a universal solvent-removal input.

gaps.title: Before-capture intensity of capture-equipped plants
gaps.text: The unabated SMR coefficient H52 should not be transferred to SMR+CCS or ATR+CCS; their fuel and process balances differ.

gaps.title: Current PEM/alkaline variable O&M
gaps.text: A comparable public benchmark excluding electricity, water and stack replacement is not established here. H27 is a model factor.

gaps.title: Current MW-scale, continuous-duty pure-hydrogen fuel cells
gaps.text: Installed CAPEX, variable O&M and lifetime require suitable public sources. Backup-system values and natural-gas CHP efficiencies are unsuitable substitutes.

gaps.title: Current storage and pipeline procurement costs
gaps.text: Historical DOE component benchmarks need newer public estimates with installation and location stated.

gaps.title: Hydrogen-only U.S. wholesale prices
gaps.text: H65 is a small retail sample. The BLS/FRED argon-and-hydrogen series is a combined index, not a hydrogen-only price per kilogram.

gaps.title: Additional California retail coverage
gaps.text: The CEC/CARB assessment is a further public reference; its numerical observations are not included in this edition.
